title: It is not possible to navigate between desktop icons in folder view using the keyboard.
line: After Show Desktop (Meta+D or Ctrl+F12) the arrow keys now move between desktop icons without clicking the desktop first.
explanation: When the desktop is created, the containment item gets keyboard focus and its onFocusChanged handler tries to pass it on to the folder view, but the folder view loader only loads once the screen is ready, so the forward hits a null item. Focus therefore stays on the containment item itself, and when Show Desktop activates the desktop window the arrow keys reach nothing; one click moved focus to the folder view, which is why clicking 'fixed' it. The change forwards the focus to the folder view when its loader finishes loading, if the containment still holds it.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: give the folder view focus once it loads

The desktop forwarded its initial focus to the folder view before the
view was loaded, so after Show Desktop the arrow keys did nothing until
the desktop was clicked once. Forward the focus when the view loads.

BUG: 519265
